summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share buyback purchases under an existing programme announced 20 May 2025. Over 25-29 May 2026, the company repurchased 7,640 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of €25.277-25.602 and 391,004 ADSs at $30.3170-30.8660 for cancellation. The filings are routine progress updates with no new programme terms or structural changes. These are open-market purchases with no fixed timeline. As a capital allocation move, the returns to shareholders are consistent. Watch for ongoing execution vs. programme authorisation. There is no risk-arb angle; it is out of any event-driven play.
